cues.zh: 从零开始制作一把石斧
cues.en: Making a stone axe from scratch

cues.zh: 从河床中挑选一块玄武岩
cues.en: Selecting a piece of basalt from the creek bed

cues.zh: 从主石上敲下较小的碎片
cues.en: Breaking smaller pieces off the main stone

cues.zh: 一大块石片剥落下来
cues.en: A large piece flaked off

cues.zh: 用敲击技术塑造刃口
cues.en: Shaping the cutting edge using a pecking technique

cues.zh: 润湿磨石，将斧头研磨成型
cues.en: Wetting a grind stone and grinding the axe head into shape

cues.zh: 更细粒度的磨石
cues.en: Finer grade of grind stone

cues.zh: 用逐级更细的石头研磨刃口
cues.en: Grinding the very edge with a progressively finer grades of stone

cues.zh: 最后用木炭做最终抛光
cues.en: Charcoal is used last for final finish

cues.zh: 用泥岩制作石凿
cues.en: Making a stone chisel from mudstone

cues.zh: 研磨凿刃
cues.en: Grinding chisel edge

cues.zh: 用木槌和凿子砍树
cues.en: Cutting tree with mallet and chisel

cues.zh: 凿出榫眼以安装石斧头
cues.en: Carving mortise to haft stone head

cues.zh: 用烧红的炭烧出榫眼，同时进行火硬化处理（防止开裂）
cues.en: A hot coal is used to burn out the mortise, fire hardening it in the process (prevents splitting)

cues.zh: 将手柄削成锥形
cues.en: Tapering the handle

cues.zh: 火硬化手柄以帮助其干燥
cues.en: Fire hardening the handle to help it dry

cues.zh: 刮削榫眼，使斧头贴合良好
cues.en: Scraping the mortise so the head fits well

cues.zh: 安装斧头
cues.en: Fitting the head

cues.zh: 注意斧头两侧不接触榫眼两侧（否则使用时会开裂）
cues.en: Notice the sides of the head do not touch the sides of the mortise (other wise it would split with use)

cues.zh: 小心敲击几下，将斧头楔入
cues.en: A few cautious hits to wedge the head in

cues.zh: 石斧的击打角度必须比现代钢斧更接近90度，否则较钝的刃口会打滑偏开
cues.en: The axe must hit at closer to 90 degrees than a modern steel axe as the blunter blade would otherwise glance off
